dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing of the body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth and symmetrical lateral margins with no discernible localized bulges or indentations along the water-line interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate grey tone with uniform median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, distinct dark longitudinal linear mark is visible on the posterior dorsal plane, slightly offset to the left of the midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Shadow-casting along the central axis indicates a raised dorsal ridge topology.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent longitudinal linear scar or rake mark is located on the posterior half of the dorsal surface.
